t1200.label: NVIDIA T1200 Laptop GPU
t1200.notes: The machine most of docs/performance.md was measured on. GPU-bound at 1080p, 4x MSAA.

rtx3060.label: NVIDIA RTX 3060 desktop
rtx3060.notes: The GPU class the High tier is designed for. The 240 Hz gate must pass here before a build is called 240 Hz ready.

rtx4070.label: NVIDIA RTX 4070 or faster
rtx4070.notes: A faster GPU than the High target. Also useful for checking CPU-bound floors on older CPUs.
